pages.title: Making Electrum
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Silver + 1 Gold = 2 Electrum

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 366 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 2.$(br)Mining efficiency: 7.9.$(br)Material damage bonus: 2.7.$(br)Enchantability: 17.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 5, leggings 4, boots 2.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 1.0.$(br)Enchantability: 19.

pages.title: Weapon: Magnet
pages.text: Activating the effect with a right click on the weapon will cause entities in line of sight of the player to be moved towards the player.

pages.title: Tool: Voltage Control
pages.text: Harvesting blocks while the effect is active (right-click) will make the tool use 10x durability but mine significantly faster and gain a higher harvest level.

pages.title: Armor: Static
pages.text: Receiving damage charges items in the player inventory with Energy. Energy is distributed equally among all items. Energy value scales based on damage received prior to armor reduction calculations.
